bole.text: Not described by a source read.

crown.text: A tree of the forest's middle stratum ('estrato medio'), among the most abundant and important species in Los Amigos floodplain plots.

leaf.under_colour: lower surface of the lamina often distinctly rugose

bark.text: Not described by a source read.

habitat.range: abundant in seasonally flooded floodplain forest of the Los Amigos and Madre de Dios rivers, SE Peru (site c. 300 m)

notes: Very poorly documented in open sources. Vela-Apaza 2024 (src 0): with Iriartea deltoidea and Euterpe precatoria the most abundant species in plots Bajio CM3, Cocha Lobo and Jacaratia, and among the top IVI species in all four plots; plots flood c. 23 days/yr. Berg 2001 Flora Neotropica 83 (src 1, discussion under P. macrophylla): P. laevis leaves can be about the size of eastern P. macrophylla; stipule hairs distinctly different and usually patent; lower lamina often distinctly rugose. 'simple' leaf type is implied by Berg's 'lamina', not stated. Wikipedia (src 2): P. ferruginea treated as a synonym; genus known as 'lechechiva'. Search snippets cited specimen labels (Tambopata: tree 15-20 m, milky brown latex, red velutinous drupes; leaves (4-)7-17(-24) x (1.5-)2.5-7(-8.5) cm; fruit c. 1.3 x 0.8 cm), but the NYBG and WorldFloraDB pages were blocked, so none entered. No frugivore source found.
